prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Houston, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1367; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?

A: It was in a parking lot in Houston, Texas, at a shopping center. I was pulling out of a parking space near the main entrance.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?

A: I was backing out slowly. I checked my mirror and saw nothing coming, but when I was about halfway out, another car came around the row from my left and hit the rear corner of my car.

Q: How fast were you traveling?

A: I was barely moving, maybe a couple of miles an hour. I had just put the car in reverse and was still on the brakes.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the collision?

A: No, not until it was right there. The lot was busy and there were a lot of cars parked along that aisle, so I couldn't see far down the row.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. I put my right arm out to brace myself when the impact pushed me against the steering wheel and door frame. My wrist hurt immediately, and the doctor later told me it's fractured.

Q: Have you received medical treatment for the wrist?

A: Yes, I was seen at an urgent care clinic that same afternoon, and I've since been referred to an orthopedic specialist. I'm wearing a splint right now.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I've been cooperative from the start and I'm willing to provide the police report and my medical records.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
